snippet.title: Prismhold - Official Trailer | Every Tower Is a Card
snippet.description:
Every tower is a card. Draft, merge and evolve 140 towers across 14 elements in a card-driven tower defense.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5421610/Prismhold/

🃏 Build your deck, then draft towers from the shop every wave
🔺 Merge three copies to evolve them, with no cap: III, IV, V and beyond
⚡ 14 elements, from dragon breath and chain lightning to black holes and falling stars
👑 A crowned boss every 10th wave, flying waves and 130 creatures
🤝 Play solo, team up with a friend on one map, or go Side by Side with up to 4 players
♾️ Endless waves, 8 maps, augments, a daily challenge, Steam leaderboards and 47 achievements

A free demo is coming soon. Add Prismhold to your Steam wishlist to get notified when it launches.
Subscribe to ACA Games to follow along.

More from ACA Games:
🐠 ARC Aquarium: a cozy aquarium where every fish is a card (free demo): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4213290/ARC_Aquarium/
⚔️ Quartermark: an idle RPG where four heroes fight on their own (free demo): https://store.steampowered.com/app/5061040/Quartermark/

#indiegame #towerdefense #deckbuilder
